name: Gift Card Magic
author: Gift Card Magic

sections.description:
Looking to create and sell unlimited gift cards on your WordPress website? Gift Card Magic is your ideal solution!

With Gift Card Magic, you can easily offer customers the perfect gift for any occasion. Designed for businesses of all types, this plugin seamlessly integrates with WordPress, making it simple to set up and manage.

Start spreading joy today with Gift Card Magic—the effortless way to boost engagement and sales on your site.
* Create a gift card product with just one click.
* Customize it easily to fit your needs.

Short Description

With Gift Card Magic, you can easily offer customers the perfect gift for any occasion.

Main Features

Frontend:
* Create and design your own templates for specific occasions or holidays.
* Fixed Value Gift Cards: Admin can provide customers with gift cards of fixed values.
* Custom Value Gift Cards: The value of the gift card can be determined by the customer.
* Customers can preview their gift cards on the checkout page.
* Purchased gift cards are sent to the recipient’s email address.
* Add a message to be printed on the gift card/PDF gift card.
* Redeem gift cards using a unique auto-generated discount code.
* Multiple payment gateway integrations like Stripe, PayPal, and Bank Transfer.
* Set an expiration date for the gift card, either as a fixed date or a number of days from the purchase.
* Remove the expiration date from the gift card.
* Shipping Method Options:
– Email: The gift card (PDF) is sent to the buyer’s email upon successful payment.
– Post: The gift card will be physically mailed to the recipient via postal service.

Backend:
* View all gift card orders.
* Track the status of all gift cards such as used or redeemed.
* View details for each gift card such as full value, remaining balance, related gift card order, applied order, and total spending.
* Create unlimited gift card categories.
* Create gift cards directly from the admin panel.
* Admin can set options like sender’s name, email, company name, and company details on the templates from the plugin settings.
* Admin can customize email templates for both themselves and their customers.
* Admin can also enable the option to send email notifications to customers.
* Customers can view a list of used gift cards, usage order, and remaining balance.

Advanced Features of Gift Card Magic Pro Plugin

  • Barcode feature that can be printed on gift card.
  • Additional charge per order for gift card issuance.
  • Customizable redemption value from the backend.
  • Check gift card balance page in the admin section.
  • Generate invoices for each gift card order.
  • Customize gift card text colors and fonts to match your brand or occasion.
  • Option to hide prices on gift cards for a more personalized feel.
  • Remove gift card titles for a cleaner design.
  • Set the desired coupon code length for added security.
  • Easily add your logo to each gift card for professional branding.
  • Offer multiple currency options for customer convenience at checkout.
  • 1-year support with included updates.
  • 100% satisfaction guarantee (money-back within 14 days if not satisfied).

Future Updates

  • WooCommerce payment gateway integration.
  • Support for more languages to accommodate global users.
  • More gift card templates to offer customers a wider range of options.

Donate

  • If you enjoy using Gift Card Magic and would like to support its continued development, consider making a donation to help us keep improving and adding new features. Donate here.
sections.installation:
1. Unzip the downloaded plugin zip file.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress site.
  3. Activate the ‘Gift Card Magic’ plugin from the Plugins page.
sections.faq:
Q: Can I offer both fixed and custom value gift cards?

A: Yes, you can offer both fixed-value and custom-value gift cards. Admins can set fixed values or let customers choose the gift card amount.

Q: Can I set an expiration date for the gift cards?

A: Yes, you can set an expiration date either as a fixed date or a number of days from the purchase. You can also remove the expiration date entirely if you prefer.

Q: What payment gateways are supported?

A: Gift Card Magic integrates with Stripe, PayPal, and Bank Transfer for easy payment processing.
sections.changelog:
Version 1.1.0 – Released: January 8, 2025

  • Features: Added language support for German (de_DE) and French (fr_FR).
  • Improved plugin structure to accommodate translations.

Version 1.0.0 – Released: November 13/2024

  • First release of the Gift Card Magic plugin.
